					change_resource_potential = { type = building_gold_mine amount = -1 }
					change_resource_potential = { type = building_gold_mine_atmospheric_engine_pump amount = 2 }
					change_resource_potential = { type = building_gold_mine_condensing_engine_pump amount = 2 }
					change_resource_potential = { type = building_gold_mine_diesel_pump amount = 2 }
				}
			}
		}
		if = { limit = { state_region = s:STATE_BURYATIA }
			state_region = {

					set_variable = pmr_gold_spread

					change_resource_potential = { type = building_gold_mine_atmospheric_engine_pump amount = 8 }
